established_rules: Numeric helpers zero all outputs before a bounded fgets read of at most 1023 bytes, replace commas before the first NUL, and report failure only for failed line read or scanf return -1.
Partial conversions remain successful and retain zero-filled suffixes. Connectivity helpers read a label plus four or eight integers; coordinates read a label plus two or three doubles.
Integer conversion uses base-detecting %i semantics. The observed cases include decimal, leading-zero octal and hexadecimal forms.

The legacy floating scanner accepts decimal significands and e/E exponents. It consumes incomplete exponent suffixes such as e+ but converts the significand; 1e+ becomes 1 and following values are still parsed.
Hexadecimal floating syntax is not recognized. At 0x1p2 the first float consumes only 0, and the next conversion fails at x. Signed zero is preserved.
Adjacent decimal forms can be separate conversions without whitespace: 1.2.3 produces 1.2 then 0.3.

OBJNAM reads and discards the current-line remainder, reads the next bounded line, copies at most 80 bytes and trims trailing spaces/CR/LF/NUL. Leading whitespace and trailing tabs are not trimmed. Failed reads preserve the previous name.
The original file-open mode bytes are r followed by NUL. The component accepts already translated text bytes; it does not implement Windows file translation.

validation.comparison: Exact helper status, conversion count, consumed line bytes, integer/double output bytes, and logical name bytes through first NUL.
validation.result: All compared calls pass; independent provenance checks reject 20 tampering cases.
validation.candidate_history: Initial direct modern-CRT substitution failed with 17 field differences across six rows. It was replaced with a recovered decimal lexer. Candidate sources were frozen before held-out capture and remained unchanged through evaluation.
validation.binary_retention: The executable was relinked later when the shared library gained mesh deactivation. Its current hash differs from the pre-evaluation freeze; unchanged reader sources and a fresh passing replay are recorded. The pre-evaluation executable was not separately archived.

design_choices: Portable byte storage with an explicit cursor and recorded line-read attempts.
C-locale modern sscanf retains integer conversions; an explicit decimal lexer feeds bounded decimal strings to strtod.
Name comparison preserves logical content, not native buffer padding or physical allocation.
remaining: Full keyword token dispatch, recognized unsupported records, object ID parsing, model mutation and end-of-file finalization.
Runtime coverage for token39 boundaries, line1023 boundaries and nonzero blank-line-skip flags.
Complete Windows text translation, embedded NUL/Ctrl-Z and locale behavior.
Integer overflow, floating overflow/underflow, full decimal rounding equivalence and allocation failure.
Token and line methods have recovered static rules; this row-helper comparison does not establish complete token-parser equivalence.
